static_source_review: Read current AGENTS.md, onboarding, accepted build decisions and only the relevant unit plan/progress. Reviewed the actual five-file candidate and narrow prose changes against the assigned HEAD.

The preserved save, negative-exit run and interrupt functions are AST-identical. Guard changes only add recipe-object preimage checks. All old contract input, tool and source bindings remain unchanged; the editor-service rule is imported from the exact bound prior helper.

Confinement, capacity, canonical lease, default profile and final preservation behavior are retained. Explicit -E -B launchers retain failure propagation and assertion-enabled Python. No shared source/build/prefix output is introduced.

Both private runtime variants copy the same 127 objects, substitute one rebuilt mapping object, and redirect compile output, dependency output, link output and signing target into the fresh normalized private directory. Structured argv preserves the captured recipe; the copied source adds its original parent include path.

The unchanged private ASan must raise TimeoutExpired at 20 seconds, end with -SIGTERM, retain empty main stdout and load the exact original copy. Unexpected completion/non-timeout failure propagates. Signal handlers are restored after this expected timeout.

The unchanged seven-case loop requires clean exit 0 or intended diagnostic exit 86, exact reflection stdout, and exact selected sanitizer paths. Patched ASan serves address and combined modes; standalone UBSan uses the installed original runtime. Successful cases remain prerequisites to overall PASS.

The patch matches the independently reviewed source/preimage/postimage hashes; the retained source-only review does not establish allocation behavior, readable/live dyld pointer lifetime or successful startup.
